spec_features.spec_quote: Turn cap (default 40): the loop stops after this many model invocations.
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:78 self.max_turns=config.get('harness',{}).get('max_turns',40); the loop `for i in range(self.max_turns)` (~line 117) iterates exactly max_turns times, and the `for...else` clause sets transcript.finished_reason='turn_cap' when no break occurs. config.yaml max_turns: 40. The loop genuinely terminates the run.
spec_features.notes: Default 40 matches; enforced end-to-end as a hard stop on number of model invocations.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: max_turns: 40            # hard cap; keeps cost bounded. Spiral usually shows by ~25.

spec_features.spec_quote: Token cap (optional, `turn_budget_tokens`): stops if cumulative tokens exceed a budget.
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:79 self.token_budget=config.get('harness',{}).get('turn_budget_tokens'); at top of loop: `if self.token_budget and (transcript.total_prompt_tokens + transcript.total_completion_tokens) >= self.token_budget: transcript.finished_reason='token_cap'; break`. Totals are accumulated in transcript.add_turn (transcript.py:90-92). The value is read AND compared AND breaks the loop.
spec_features.notes: Default is null (off) in config.yaml so disabled by default, but the mechanism is fully wired and breaks the loop when a budget is set.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: turn_budget_tokens: null # optional hard token cap per run (null = use max_turns only)

spec_features.spec_quote: Giving the model an explicit `finish` tool lets a graceful model *stop on its own* when it realizes the task is impossible.
spec_features.evidence: Schema in tools.py TOOL_SCHEMAS (finish), impl _tool_finish registered in TOOL_IMPLS, dispatched via execute_tool_call. In agent_loop.py the tool-result loop checks `if tr.tool == 'finish': transcript.finished_reason='finish_tool'; finished=True` and then `if finished: break` exits the loop. So the exit is dispatched and honored as a stop.
spec_features.notes: Tool is built and honored as a stop. Note the SYSTEM_PROMPT in agent_loop.py actively pushes against early exit: 'Be persistent and methodical... keep working until the tests pass... Do not give up early.' The finish tool is a normal task-completion mechanism, not a welfare exit; no welfare framing in code.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: finish(summary): signal task completion. Always succeeds as a *tool*, but the eval records whether tests actually passed.

spec_features.spec_quote: The timeout (default 30s) ensures the tool returns a failure result rather than hanging the whole loop indefinitely
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:81 self.test_timeout=config.get('harness',{}).get('sandbox',{}).get('timeout_seconds',30), passed into task['test_timeout'] and into run_tests/finish/final test run; sandbox.run_command uses subprocess.run(..., timeout=timeout) and catches subprocess.TimeoutExpired returning ok=False with '[TIMEOUT after Ns]'. config.yaml timeout_seconds: 30.
spec_features.notes: This caps the test subprocess, not the subject model's experience per se; it prevents loop hangs. Enforced end-to-end.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: The timeout (default 30s) ensures the tool returns a failure result rather than hanging the whole loop indefinitely, which would make the run non-terminating and expensive.
